missing: A direct, tested pick for two Macs: which 2-bay actually handles two concurrent Time Machine backups cleanly, with current enclosure-plus-drive prices and the per-Mac quota setup confirmed on each OS.
why: No major reviewer or authority tests 2-bay NAS for multi-Mac Time Machine. Apple's page is protocol guidance with no products; AppleInsider's piece is an untested sub-$300 roundup pegged to a Time Capsule news hook. The rest are affiliate listicles (several on recycled "November 2026 Honest Reviews" domains claiming testing nobody can check) and setup guides without picks. A focused page comparing 2-bay units on concurrent Time Machine throughput, quota support, and total cost with drives, with current prices, would stand out.
